history.body: Hi, we’re comparing condos around Seberang Jaya for our own stay, and Pearl Residences seems a little expensive from what I’ve seen. Could you help me understand what the price includes and how it compares on overall value?

Fair question, especially when you’re comparing for your own stay. The price structure can include the unit’s base price and an applicable car-park premium; some units may also have extra motorcycle bay or utility charges, and an upgrading package. Any rebate or package is separate and depends on the exact unit category, floor and car-park allocation.

The pricing reference I have is indicative, not a confirmed current quote, so I don’t want to give you a figure that may be out of date. For context, the Phase 1 Type A is 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony; you can weigh that layout against the final total cost when comparing options. I’ll request the latest unit-specific breakdown and package. If you have another condo’s quote, feel free to share it and I can help compare the inclusions like-for-like.

Thanks, that helps explain why the headline price can differ from the final amount. I don’t have a formal quote from another condo yet, just a few lower advertised prices I’ve seen. Could you send the current total for a Type A with one car park and note any required extra charges? The layout could work for us, but I’d like to compare the full costs first.

Absolutely—checking the full cost is the right way to compare. I don’t yet have the confirmed current unit-specific total, so I can’t responsibly quote a figure or say which extras are compulsory. For a Type A with one car park, the breakdown needs to confirm the applicable base price and car-park premium, plus whether any motorcycle-bay or utility charges, upgrade items, or current package/rebate apply. That pricing check is still pending; once confirmed, I’ll share the itemised total so you can compare it properly.
